transcript.content: Hello, and welcome. I'm Dr. [Name], a psychiatrist. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi, doctor. Well, I came in because for the last few weeks, I've just barely had an appetite. It's been a bit weird. Usually, after a long shift, I'm pretty ready to eat, but lately... I don't know, even the foods I usually like just sit there in front of me. I basically have to force myself to choke down a few bites, and that's about it. I figured I should probably come in and talk to someone about it.
Over these past few weeks when your appetite has been low, how has your mood been? Have you been feeling sad, down, or empty?

Yeah, I guess I have. Most days lately, I just feel like I’m carrying this heavy, flat feeling around with me. It's like... even when I’m home with my family, or just sitting in the break room at work, I’m just not really there. Just kind of empty, I suppose.
You mentioned these feelings have been going on for a few weeks — can you tell me more specifically how long this has been happening? When did it start?

I'd say it's been right about three weeks now. It started right around the time the casino reorganized our security operations. They changed up my assignments, and... yeah, that's pretty much when I started noticing it.
Besides the low mood and loss of appetite you mentioned, have you been feeling particularly anxious, worried, or on edge during these past three weeks?

No, not really. I haven't been feeling anxious or worried about anything. It's not like I'm pacing around or feeling on edge... it's just more of that flat feeling I mentioned. So, no, I wouldn't say I've had any anxiety.
Have you experienced periods like this before — times when you felt this same kind of heavy, flat mood and lost your appetite — or is this the first time this has happened to you?

No, not really. I mean... I've had regular bad days before, sure, like anyone else. But this whole heavy feeling, and just not wanting to eat... no. This is the first time it's ever been like this for me.
How has your sleep been over these past three weeks? Have you noticed any changes — such as difficulty falling asleep, waking up in the middle of the night, or sleeping more than usual?

My sleep? It's... it's been pretty normal, honestly. I haven't really noticed any changes. I go to bed around the same time, fall asleep fine, and I don't really wake up in the middle of the night or anything. And I'm not sleeping in any later than usual. So, yeah, sleep hasn't really been an issue.

Over these past three weeks, have you noticed that things you normally enjoy doing — like hobbies, time with friends, or activities you usually find fun — just don't interest you anymore or don't feel enjoyable?

Yeah, I have noticed that. I used to really look forward to my morning runs, or playing my guitar... even just cooking dinner. But lately, I just keep skipping all of it. It’s like they just feel like chores now, and I just can’t get myself to care about doing them.
Over these past three weeks, have you noticed any difficulty concentrating or focusing — for example, trouble paying attention at work, or finding it hard to make decisions?

Yeah, I have. It's been pretty noticeable at work, actually. I watch CCTV feeds for my job, and lately... my mind just drifts. Or when I'm trying to write up incident reports, I end up having to reread things over and over again just to get through it. It's frustrating because I've actually ended up making a few mistakes that I normally wouldn't make, just because I can't seem to keep my focus.
Over these past three weeks, have you been feeling guilty about anything, or like you're worthless or to blame for things?

No, not really. I mean, I don't feel like I'm worthless or anything like that. And I haven't really been feeling guilty about anything, either. I'm just struggling with the focus and the lack of interest, but I don't feel like I'm to blame for it or anything.
Over these past three weeks, have you noticed that you're feeling tired or lacking in energy, even when you're not doing much physically demanding?

No, my energy levels have been fine, really. I mean, my job isn't physically demanding anyway since I'm mostly just sitting and watching monitors, but I haven't felt physically drained or unusually tired. It's really just the lack of interest and the focus issues I mentioned, not a lack of actual energy.
Over these past three weeks, have you had any thoughts about death, or about harming yourself in any way?

I'm not planning to hurt myself, no. But I do keep having these thoughts lately... that maybe it wouldn't be the worst thing if I just didn't wake up. Just so I wouldn't have to keep pushing through all this, you know?
